lua.code:
ti[" "] = {"fl_water"}
ti["~"] = ti[" "] .. {"it_sensor", invisible=true, target="build_bridge"}
ti["="] = {"fl_hay"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti["@"] = ti["="] .. ti({"#ac_marble_black"}) .. {"it_document", text="text1"}

wo(ti, " ", {
    "                    ",
    " ~O~~~~~~~~~~~~=~~~ ",
    " ~=~~~=~O~=~=~~~~O~ ",
    " ~~~=~~~~~~~~~=~=~~ ",
    " ~~~~~~~~=~~~~~~~~= ",
    " ~=O~=~=~~~~~~=~~~~ ",
    " ~~~~~~~~@~~O~~~~~~ ",
    " ~=~~~=~~~~~~=~~~~~ ",
    " ~~~~~~~=~~=~~~~=~~ ",
    " ~=~~~~O~~~~~~~~~~~ ",
    " ~~~=~=~~~~~~=~~=~~ ",
    " O=~~~~~~~=~~~~~~O~ ",
    "                    "})

local supplies = 24
function build_bridge(value, sender)
    if supplies > 0 then
        sender.target = DEFAULT
        wo[sender] = ti["="]
        supplies = supplies-1
    end
end

wo:shuffleOxyd()

ti[" "] = {"fl_wood"}
ti["#"] = {"st_brownpyramid"}
ti["*"] = {"st_stoneimpulse"}
ti["+"] = {"st_stoneimpulse_movable"}
ti["M"] = {"st_box"}
ti["."] = {"st_grate_cross"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd", flavor = "c", oxydcolor = OXYD_RED}
ti["P"] = {"st_oxyd", flavor = "c", oxydcolor = OXYD_CYAN}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble", adhesion = 1} .. ti["."]
ti["d"] = {"it_document", text = "text1"} .. ti["."]
ti["1"] = {"fl_wood", "door1#"} .. ti["."]
ti["2"] = {"fl_wood", "door2#"} .. ti["."]
ti["3"] = {"fl_wood", "door3#"} .. ti["."]
ti["t"] = {"it_trigger", target = "close_doors"}
ti["T"] = {"st_timer", "timer#", target = "open_doors", interval = 3.0, _motion = false}

if wo["IsDifficult"] then
  ti[":"] = {}
else
  ti[":"] = ti["."]
end

w, h = wo(ti, " ",
       {" ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " ",
        "###              ###",
        "**#              #**",
        "*M#              #M*",
        "*tT###        ###Tt*",
        "*****##########*****",
        "*O1 +          + 1P*",
        "*23.+          +.32*",
        "*+++ + + ++ + + +++*",
        "#   +   +@d+   +   #",
        "#   +...+  +...+   #",
        "#::::+ +    + +::::#",
        "#   +...+  +...+   #",
        "#   +   +..+   +   #",
        "*+++ + + ++ + + +++*",
        "*23.+          +.32*",
        "*P1 +          + 1O*",
        "*****##########*****",
        "*tT###        ###Tt*",
        "*M#              #M*",
        "**#              #**",
        "###              ###",
        " ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " ", " "})

timers = no["timer#*"]
doors1 = no["door1#*"]
doors2 = no["door2#*"]
doors3 = no["door3#*"]

function close_doors(is_on, sender)
  timers:nearest(sender)._motion = true
  wo[doors1:nearest(sender)] = ti["#"]
  wo[doors2:nearest(sender)] = ti["#"]
  wo[doors3:nearest(sender)] = ti["#"]
end

function open_doors(is_on, sender)
  if sender._motion then
    sender._motion = false
  else
    wo[doors1:nearest(sender)] = ti["."]
    wo[doors2:nearest(sender)] = ti["."]
    wo[doors3:nearest(sender)] = ti["."]
  end
end

wo:shuffleOxyd()

texts.text1: As long as there is motion around the oxyd-stones, you won't reach them.   So: Don't lose control of the level! It's possible.

texts.text2: Congratulations, you reached this side ...     but can you get to the oxyds?

texts.text1: Too many wooden blocks!  Try the other way ...
texts.text2: Greetings, adventurer!    The road ahead is long and dangerous, so be careful!
